parsed.why: National seat under national legislature; a locally unrepealable facility ban attached by Congress, arrests of trans protesters, all national exposures (passport markers, entry screening) apply directly; local protectiveness overridable without local change.

Own bathroom ban in schools and government buildings with a public reporting form and a documentary defence visitors cannot satisfy; pride-flag fines; care ban; adds a state-hostile layer on top of the parent regime.

No facility ban, 2013 gender-identity anti-discrimination in public accommodations, penalty enhancements, marker changes available; meaningfully above parent though national document and entry exposures remain.

Low-risk tier: robust nondiscrimination, X markers without medical proof, insured care, correctional protection statute; residual custody and healthcare-equity shortfalls keep it below the most protective tier.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodations coverage, hate-crime law, shield laws protecting travelling visitors' care, gender-neutral bathrooms; above parent but national passport and entry regime caps it.
